title: AgentServeSim: Serving-System Simulation and Policy Search for LLM Agent Programs
abstract: arXiv:2606.09613v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model agents execute programs comprising multiple model turns interleaved with external tool calls. Their job completion time depends on how the serving system retains KV state across tool gaps, routes successor turns, and schedules competing programs. Most existing serving simulators operate on request streams in which arrivals are externally supplied and KV state follows request- or cache-scoped semantics. They therefore cannot jointly represent the cross-turn state and policy-dependent successor releases needed to evaluate counterfactual agent-serving trajectories. We present AgentServeSim, a simulator whose unit of execution is the agent program. A Program Control Block maintains cross-turn state, while a Program Orchestrator causally releases successor turns from simulated predecessor completions. A Retention Plane controls KV state across tool gaps, and a Dispatch Plane determines where and when each ready

translated_title: AgentServeSim：面向大语言模型智能体程序的服务系统仿真与策略搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.09613v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：大语言模型智能体执行的程序由多个模型回合与外部工具调用交错组成。其任务完成时间取决于服务系统如何在工具间隙期间保留KV状态、如何路由后续回合，以及如何调度相互竞争的程序。现有的大多数服务仿真器作用于请求流，其中请求到达由外部提供，KV状态遵循请求级或缓存级语义。因此，它们无法联合表示评估反事实智能体服务轨迹所需的跨回合状态和依赖策略的后续回合发布机制。我们提出了AgentServeSim，一个以智能体程序为执行单元的仿真器。其中，程序控制块维护跨回合状态，程序编排器从仿真中的前驱完成事件中因果地释放后续回合，保留平面控制工具间隙期间的KV状态，调度平面决定每个就绪回合的执行位置与时机。
tldr: 本文提出了首个以智能体程序为执行单元的服务系统仿真器AgentServeSim，通过程序控制块、程序编排器、保留平面和调度平面共同建模跨回合状态与策略依赖的回合释放机制，实现了对智能体服务策略的反事实评估与搜索。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AgentServeSim, the first serving-system simulator whose unit of execution is the agent program, which jointly models cross-turn state and policy-dependent successor-turn release through a Program Control Block, Program Orchestrator, Retention Plane, and Dispatch Plane, enabling counterfactual evaluation and search of agent-serving policies.
